registered: 2026-10-07 (KST), before any of these variants was run
purpose: The user proposed market-specific styles: day trading for Korea (a market with a strong day-trading culture and a small account) and longer holding for the US. Test both on the archive before anything changes on the site.

part_A_korea_day_trading.data: Yahoo hourly bars 2023-10 .. 2026-10 of the ~600 most traded Korean names (stocks and ETFs). Bars: 09:00 (open auction), 10:00, ..., 15:00 (includes the close auction).
part_A_korea_day_trading.costs: Real site costs per round trip: stocks 0.33% (fee 0.015% x2, sell tax 0.20%, slippage 0.05% x2), ETFs 0.13% (no tax). Every position is closed by the 15:00 bar's close (no overnight).

variants.D0: every day, buy at the open, sell at the close (the base rate of holding a Korean name for one session)
variants.D1: gap up >= 2% at the open: buy at the 10:00 bar's open (after the first hour), sell at the close (momentum continuation)
variants.D2: first hour up >= 1% with first-hour volume >= 1.5x its 20-day average first hour: buy at the 10:00 bar's open, sell at the close
variants.D3: gap down <= -2% at the open: buy at the open, sell at the close (opening reversal)
variants.D4: the site's daily rule signal (any of the four, as of the previous close): buy at the open, sell at the close
variants.D5: opening range breakout: after the first hour, buy when a later hour trades above the first hour's high (filled at that high), stop at the first hour's low, otherwise sell at the close

part_A_korea_day_trading.adopt: A variant may become the Korean style only if, for Korean STOCKS (the site trades stocks there), its mean per trade after costs is > 0 AND the 95% interval (trades in the same month counted as one draw) is entirely above 0 in BOTH halves, with at least 300 trades in each half. If none passes, Korea keeps the swing style and the report says so.

part_B_us_longer_holding.data: research.json (registered 2026-10-03): the stop/take/hold grid already run on 2006-2018 (develop) and 2019-2026 (holdout).
part_B_us_longer_holding.candidates: stop 2.0x or 3.0x ATR with take 1.5x/2.0x/3.0x, hold 21; and hold 42/63 with the base stop
part_B_us_longer_holding.adopt: For US stocks AND US ETFs: the candidate with the best develop mean replaces the base only if its holdout mean is also above the base in both groups. A portfolio check (portfolio.py, the site's 17 US names, 750 USD) must then show a max drawdown no deeper than holding the S&P 500 ETF over the same period; otherwise the next best passing candidate is tried, and if none passes the US keeps the base.

after: Anything adopted is a strategy change: it becomes a setting of NEW experiments only; the running experiment is not changed.
